question: Can a small fixed-gain correction from past observed forecast residuals adapt a train-only curvature predictor to an unseen dynamic regime without overreacting to sensor noise, improving on W-R22/W-R23 naive online strategies?
hypothesis: Causal correction by 1/4 of the previous one-step frozen-model residual, or median of three recent residuals, may improve heldout late-period MAE while preserving early-period error; could still worsen noise.
generator: Exact W-R22 synthetic first-channel quadratic dynamics with nondegenerate development three-level jitter, heldout five-level jitter and heldout-only added second-curvature term 2*max(0,t-8)^2. Fresh seeds development96..99 and heldout100..103, nine entities and 16 ticks per seed. No future target observation consulted by any predictor.
arms: naive local last-second-difference online curvature (W-R22 control)
frozen curvature + 1/4 of immediately previous causal one-step frozen-model forecast residual
frozen curvature + 1/4 of median of up to three most recent causal frozen-model forecast residuals
training: Learn exactly one scalar curvature estimate from development by median signed circular second differences. For residual at time j, calculate how the frozen predictor *would have predicted* already observed x(j) using x(j-1),x(j-2). For forecasting x(t), consult only residuals for j<t (no evaluation target x(t)). First residual available at j=2; for earliest t use zero correction.
capacity: All arms receive identical five-previous-observation window, one frozen development scalar, no additional persisted trainable weights or hidden state; correction gain fixed at 0.25 before first-use; median window length3 fixed; bounded O(1) arithmetic per prediction.
primary: Heldout circular absolute error per predictor, per seed, full t2..15, early t2..8 and late t9..15. FEEDBACK_TRANSFER if median-error-feedback late MAE <=.90*frozen late MAE and early <=1.10*frozen early MAE and median improves late on >=3/4 heldout seeds. PARTIAL if median improves late aggregate but misses other criteria. NEGATIVE otherwise. Preserve all negative controls.
validity: Exact Git source prereg pin; truly varying sensor jitter 3/5 levels; no future/label leakage or heldout-derived gain tuning; first-use original artifact, deterministic output and one complete regression; no accepted-ref mutation.
claim_limit: Synthetic autoregressive forecasting with causal residual feedback, not general intelligence or natural-language prediction.
